reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering grass, flowers, slime ranching, crops, explosives, bone artifacts, and books of power were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover planting instructions, machine behavior, book-title voice and wordplay, numerical effects, archaeological wording, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

BlueGrassStarter_Description.source: Place this on your farm to plant a clump of blue grass.
BlueGrassStarter_Description.translation: Așază-l la fermă pentru a planta un pâlc de iarbă albastră.

BlueJazz_Description.source: The flower grows in a sphere to invite as many butterflies as possible.
BlueJazz_Description.translation: Floarea crește în formă sferică pentru a atrage cât mai mulți fluturi.

BlueSlimeEgg_Description.source: Can be hatched in a slime incubator.
BlueSlimeEgg_Description.translation: Poate ecloza într-un Incubator de Slime.

BokChoy_Description.source: The leafy greens and fibrous stalks are healthy and delicious.
BokChoy_Description.translation: Frunzele verzi și tulpinile fibroase sunt sănătoase și delicioase.

BokChoySeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 4 days to mature.
BokChoySeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le toamna. Ajung la maturitate în 4 zile.

BoneFlute_Description.source: It's a prehistoric wind instrument carved from an animal's bone. It produces an eerie tone.
BoneFlute_Description.translation: Este un instrument de suflat preistoric, sculptat dintr-un os de animal. Produce un sunet straniu.

Book_AnimalCatalogue_Description.source: You can access Marnie's shop when she's not around.
Book_AnimalCatalogue_Description.translation: Poți accesa magazinul lui Marnie când ea nu este prin preajmă.

Book_Artifact_Description.source: You will fetch a better price when selling artifacts.
Book_Artifact_Description.translation: Vei obține un preț mai bun când vinzi artefacte.

Book_Bombs_Description.source: Bombs deal 25% less damage to you.
Book_Bombs_Description.translation: Bombele îți provoacă cu 25% mai puține daune.

Book_Crabbing_Description.source: Crab pots have a 25% chance to yield double.
Book_Crabbing_Description.translation: Capcanele pentru crabi au 25% șanse să producă o cantitate dublă.

Book_Defense_Name.source: Jack Be Nimble, Jack Be Thick
Book_Defense_Name.translation: Jack, fii sprinten, Jack, fii vânjos
